name: SHORT-DESCRIPTION
data: The Richard is a double storage bed with no visible feet and a thick low-to-the-floor bed surround. Its edges curve outwards, expanding the supporting base at the bottom, echoing the curvature of the headboard to suggest a mattress resting upon a raised platform. A harmonious project studied with meticulous care, Richard creates uniformity and continuity between the headboard and bed surround. A rolled effect at the sides of the padded headboard, folded back on itself in two gentle curls protruding slightly beyond the bed surround, provides an immediate sense of softness and comfort. Upholstered in fabric, micro nubuck, synthetic leather or soft leather as per sample card, slats are included, with optional pull-up slats with container available.
